payload.instruction: transform the black DVD into a white DVD
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Compare the small square DVD case near the center of the source image with that same location/object in the edited image. Is the DVD itself visibly transformed from black to white?
node.criteria: Complete only if the source's small square DVD case is identifiable as the same target in the edit and its DVD is visibly white. Partial if that same target shows a clear change toward white but is not white. Absent if the same target remains unchanged/black, or if white discs appear elsewhere without evidence that the bound DVD itself was transformed. Unknown if the target's identity or color change cannot be established from the images.
node.binding: Target: the small square DVD case near the center of the source image, with its visible rectangular outline and printed face. Compare that same case/DVD in the edited image; do not bind to the black animal-like object or to newly appearing round discs elsewhere.

outcome.description: Change the DVD from black to white.

response.content: {"status":"absent","evidence":"The small square printed DVD case near the center of the source is not identifiable in the edited image. The white round discs appear elsewhere, so they do not establish that the bound DVD was transformed.","confidence":0.98}
